open_questions: Bearing seats, shoulders, the drive end and the shaft length beyond the support bearings are not stated; the shaft is modelled as a plain D100.0 cylinder ending at the support stations (z = +-115), per the intent.
The packet does not state that the bush sits mid-way between the support bearings; the intent places the bush axial centreline at the mid-span origin.
The support span of 230 mm is taken as bearing centre to bearing centre and the stations are modelled as the end faces; the bearing widths and seat positions are not stated.
'Manufactured within a tolerance of 0.01 mm' is read as +-0.01 mm on the diameter (radius +-0.005); a total band of 0.01 would halve it.
The two ultrasonic film sensors, the shaft thermocouples (1 mm below the surface) and the RLS magnetic ring are not modelled; their axial and angular positions are not stated.
Density 7850 kg/m3 is a handbook value for EN24T; the packet does not state it.
End-face chamfers or edge breaks are not stated; sharp edges are modelled.
